articles.title: August 10, 2026
articles.description: 🚨 JAMAHAL HILL WANTS JOSH HOKIT AT HEAVYWEIGHT! 🚨 If Jamahal Hill makes the move to heavyweight, he already knows exactly who he wants standing across from him: Josh Hokit. “That’s definitely the fight I want. More than any other fight, that’s the one I want.” Hill also says he’s completely on board with Hokit’s wild personality and trash talk, praising him for getting fans invested and bringing more attention and energy to the sport. “He’s getting eyes on the sport… and he’s putting on hell of fights.” And Hill is already anticipating what the buildup would look like: “I feel like he’s going to say some crazy shit before that fight.” 😂 Former UFC light heavyweight champion vs. one of the heavyweight division’s most talked-about personalities. 👇 DO YOU WANT JAMAHAL HILL vs. JOSH HOKIT?
